points.text: Performing wudu with specific supplications for each body part creates angels for every drop, earning continuous reward until the Day of Resurrection.
The Imam performed istinjāʾ, rinsed his mouth, sniffed water, washed his face, hands, head, and feet while reciting specific prayers for each action.
The Imam wiped over his two sandals rather than passing beneath the straps during ablution.
The Imam preferred to pour water himself rather than having others do so, to avoid associating anyone with his prayer.
The Imam recited specific invocations praising Allah's names and dominion, asking for repentance, purification, and the opening of good things.
